messages:
Sam K: Heads-up — customers hitting runtime error after 0.12.0 publish. Edge functions fail during import, looks like our ESM file and sourcemaps are missing from the package. Anyone seen this before? :facepalm:

Lina W: Uh, saw something in CI logs earlier that dropped `.mjs` outputs. Might be the rollup config change from last week (switched to `preserveModules` and we didn't include `.mjs` in the files list).

Marco R: Can you paste the stack trace and package.json exports?

Sam K: Stack trace from a Vercel edge build: 
```
Error: Cannot find module '/vercel/path0/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.mjs'
    at Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```
And our package.json exports currently: 
```json
{
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs"
    }
  },
  "files": ["dist"]
}
```
But `npm pack` shows index.mjs is not in the tarball. 

publish-bot: publish pipeline log: `Skipping file: dist/index.mjs (not matched by include patterns)`. Detected `.npmignore` had `dist/**/*.mjs` added by accident in https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/commit/6a7f2a.

Lina W: Yep that explains it. We accidentally ignored `.mjs` at some point. Also noticed `.map` files were excluded so debugging is a pain for customers.

Marco R: Quick mitigation: revert the .npmignore change and cut a patch, or temporarily change package.json exports to point `import` to the `.cjs` file (not ideal for edge runtimes). Recommend patch and re-publish 0.12.1. Also we should add a publish-time check: `npm pack --dry-run` + verify `dist/index.mjs` and `dist/index.d.ts` are present.

Sam K: Agreed. Also need to check TypeScript users — some reported missing types (`index.d.ts` missing) which is probably the same ignore issue.

Jen T: I'll open a PR to revert the .npmignore and update CI to run the pack check + assert exports map points to actual files. Adding a quick test in `ci/publish.sh`: 
```sh
npm pack --dry-run > /tmp/pack.txt
grep -q "dist/index.mjs" /tmp/pack.txt || (echo "MISSING ESM ENTRY" && exit 1)
grep -q "dist/index.d.ts" /tmp/pack.txt || (echo "MISSING TYPES" && exit 1)
```

Marco R: Also let's add a linter rule for package.json `exports` keys — ensure both `require` and `import` exist and files referenced are in `files` list. Could add a small Node check in `devx` scripts.

Sam K: For immediate customer workaround, tell them to pin 0.11.x or use `require('@redwood/sdk').default`? But that might break edge imports. Better to publish patch asap.

Lina W: PR opened and CI green, reverted .npmignore + added `pack` assertions. Will hold the release until we confirm tarball contains `.mjs`, `.map`, and `.d.ts`.

publish-bot: Published pre-release 0.12.1-rc.1 (dry-run). Tarball contains: dist/index.cjs, dist/index.mjs, dist/index.mjs.map, dist/index.d.ts.

Jen T: Pushed 0.12.1 with the fix. Monitoring error rate and support tickets. Will follow up if any residual parity issues (auth/retry code path) pop up — that's separate but flagged while triaging.

Sam K: Thanks everyone — adding a short postmortem note to the release channel and updating onboarding docs to show how to validate package contents before depending on the new version. :+1:
